headline: Threads rolls out Meta AI chatbot in DMs for private conversations
summary: Users can now chat privately with Meta AI within Threads DMs, share posts and links, and ask follow-up questions.
details: Meta is integrating its AI chatbot, Meta AI, directly into Threads' direct messages, allowing users to have private conversations with the assistant.
This new feature expands on previous functionality where Meta AI was only accessible in public Threads posts, similar to Grok on X.
The move aims to keep users within Meta's ecosystem by providing a convenient way to access AI assistance without needing third-party apps like ChatGPT or Google Gemini.
Meta AI is already a feature in DMs across Meta's other platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp.
Users can now share Threads posts, images, links, and videos directly with Meta AI in their DMs, enabling deeper dives into topics through follow-up questions.
The update is rolling out globally starting Monday, with Meta continuing to test Meta AI in public Threads feeds in select markets and gathering feedback.
caption:
Threads users can now chat privately with Meta AI in their DMs, sharing posts and links directly with the assistant.

Meta is integrating its AI chatbot, Meta AI, directly into Threads' direct messages, allowing users to have private conversations with the assistant.

This new feature expands on previous functionality where Meta AI was only accessible in public Threads posts, similar to Grok on X.

The move aims to keep users within Meta's ecosystem by providing a convenient way to access AI assistance without needing third-party apps like ChatGPT or Google Gemini.

Meta AI is already a feature in DMs across Meta's other platforms, including Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp.

Users can now share Threads posts, images, links, and videos directly with Meta AI in their DMs, enabling deeper dives into topics through follow-up questions.

The update is rolling out globally starting Monday, with Meta continuing to test Meta AI in public Threads feeds in select markets and gathering feedback.
